module.description: The Patator module to execute, such as ftp_login, ssh_login, or http_fuzz.

host.description: The target host IP address or hostname.

user.description: The user parameter. Use FILE0 to read from user_file.

password.description: The password parameter. Use FILE1 to read from password_file.

user_file.description: Path to the file containing usernames to try.

password_file.description: Path to the file containing passwords to try.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries for a single candidate before giving up.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for each connection attempt.

threads.description: Number of concurrent threads to use.

ignore_mesg.description: Message regex to match for ignoring results (e.g., 'Login incorrect').

extra_args.description: List of additional key=value arguments for specific modules (e.g., 'method=POST'). For simple login modules, this is often empty.
